page.layout: One printed page with running head at top; main text in one block of justified lines; marginal notes in the left margin (small italic, beside the first lines) and right margin (small notes beside the text); section heading "CONTEMPORANEA." centred within the text; page number at top right.

main_text.p: Jerem. 52. 4. 6. 10, 11.PArem ifti cum antecefforibus fortunam ha-buere, Jechonias enim tertio regni mense, in exilium Babyloniam deportatus eft. Zedekias Joliæ F. Ægyptiorum, Ammoniorum, Moabita-rum & Tyriorum focietate ac fœdere animatus, neglecto quod fanctè promiserat tributo, & li-bertate & regno excidit. Nebucadnezar enim Hierololymam, frustra eam liberare volente, Jerem. 52. 4. 6. 10, 11.3360 Aprie, cepit, Zedekiam ex fuga retractum ocu-lis privavit, & Babylonem traduxit, principibus interfectis, templum, regiam ac civitatem igne, succendit. Sic finis regno Judaico impositus est. Jeremias e fovea, in quàm Regis jussu conjectus erat, liberatus, occiso Gedalia, in Ægyptum cum rel.qui's migravit. Sic coacti sunt Judæi deserere illam terram, cujus fingularis erat à Deo prærogativa. Ad illam certe solam leges in Ara-bum desertis latæ pertinebant, in solâ crimina-lia judicia exercebantur, qui solum patrium, Cuneg Reip. Ebr. L 1. c. 8. ex Maimo-nidis,migrandi libidine vertisset, pro syderum cultore habebatur, & quamvis post Babylonienses Judæi Remp. quandam interse haberent, tamen de-judicijs ne in ditione quidem sua cognovere.
main_text.head: CONTEMPORANEA.
main_text.p: ASIATICALYDIS imperabat adhuc Cyaxares, Jo seph. contr. Appion.3354 Apud TYRIOS fuccessit Ithobaali, anno regni sui nono mortuo, Baal.

In MEDIA excepit Cyaxarem Astyages, Justin. l. 1. Herod. l. 1.qui in somniis de nepotis magnitudine monitus (vidit nempe ex naturalibus filiæ Mandanes, quam unicam habebat, vitem enatam, cujus palmite omnis Asia obumbraretur, & arioli, consulti nepoti ex eâ magnitudinem præanunciari.

page.notes: Marginal text partly small and faint; the readings of several side notes (e.g. Jerem. references, Justin, Herodot.) and the page number "175" are uncertain. The left margin note beside the first line is a parallel reference (Jo seph. lib.). Some marginal words are illegible at this resolution; the marginal "3360" and "3354" are section numbers in the margin.
